title: Mobile section · 4 cards with glyphs
description: Mobile-experience section for hub pages. Centered H2 + 3 ledes + 4 cards, each with a glyph chip, title, and 2 body paragraphs. Light tinted background (--color-gray-bg) so the section sits visually between white sections.

source.adapted_from: v5 dark → light tokens. Glyphs simplified to neutral stroke-only icons.
source.decision: PM lock 2026-05-21 — mobile section pattern = 4-card glyph (vs photo composite)

gradient.recommended: subtle neutral/accent gradient only; do not use freeform decorative orbs

notes: Background is decorative and must not replace content media slots or block copy.
Preview in any supported harness with ?bg=gradient or ?bg=image&bgImage=<encoded-url>.

params.default: Built for the Field, Not for the Desk
The ServiceWand field app is a full operations surface, not a read-only schedule view.
Designed for the realities of working outside — gloves, connectivity gaps, noisy environments, time pressure.
Techs complete real work without bouncing back to the office for status updates or re-entry.
Notes, photos, parts, signatures, and time captured against the job.
No paper, no end-of-day rekeying back at the office.
Techs keep working with no connectivity — basements, rural sites, dead-zone neighborhoods.
Changes sync automatically once the device comes back online.
Reassignments, new urgent stops, ETAs, and customer notes push to the phone immediately.
Dispatchers don't have to call to confirm the tech saw the change.
Generate, present, and take payment for invoices from the phone while the work is still in the customer's mind.
Same data flows back to billing and accounting without re-entry.

notes: Section background is intentionally tinted (--color-gray-bg) so this section reads as a visual break between two white sections.
Glyphs are neutral stroke icons (notepad, check-circle, trending-up, clock). Replace per CMS by editing the inline SVG inside [data-glyph-slot='NN'].
Breakpoints: 4 → 2 cols at 1180px, 2 → 1 col at 720px (matches features.card-grid-4).
